 Order

This is first application filed under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nyay Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail on behalf of applicant Vivek Bharti who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.149/2024 dated 16/09/2024 registered at Police Station Isha Nagar, district Chhatarpur, for the offence punishable under Sections 420 and 409 of IPC.

This anticipatory application has been argued on the grounds that applicant is falsely implicated in this case; he was posted as Branch Manager, Ishanagar, district Chhatarpur, since 1.4.2023; along with other societies, his Society too was directed to provide the list of eligible farmers as on the date of 31.3.2023 for loan-waivers and said list was prepared by NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:17218 2 MCRC-8779-2025 other office bearers; a false FIR was registered under Sections 420 and 409 IPC against the applicant showing the wrongful disbursement of an amount of Rs.64,00,000/-.
It is submitted that the entire amount allegedly debited from the accounts has already been credited in bank and, therefore, there is no embezzlement or criminal breach of trust.
It is also submitted that no one was cheated by the act of applicant, therefore, a request has been made for grant of anticipatory bail application.

sentences.text: State has opposed the application on the grounds that applicant was instrumental in preparing the list of wrong beneficiaries and under this list a huge amount was dishonestly deposited in favour of ineligible persons.

The directions given about this deposit was also violated; the amount deposited in favour of ineligible persons was later withdrawn and misappropriated; it is being wrongly claimed by the applicant that he was not instrumental in preparing the list of ineligible beneficiaries; the list itself bears his signature; the deposit of entire amount in favour of Samiti by itself reflects that applicant was involved in embezzlement of huge public money; he along with co-accused persons has made the payment of entire defalcated amount.
The applicant, without obtaining the signature of Administrator on cheques, used his login ID and passed those cheques for payment.
A request has, therefore, been made to dismiss the application.
Counsel for both the parties have been heard the case diary has been perused.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case in their entirety, the evidence collected so far in the case diary, the prima facie involvement of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:17218 3 MCRC-8779-2025 applicant in this crime involving huge public amount, no case for release of applicant on anticipatory bail is made out.
Although an order passed in Writ Petition No.27484/2024 is relied upon by counsel for the applicant, but that order does not restrain the initiation of criminal proceedings.
Accordingly, the application is dismissed.
